entities.name: Candida albicans beta-tubulin P10875
observations: Supplied 449-aa sequence is an exact 100% full-length match to reviewed UniProt P10875, Candida albicans beta-tubulin.
Sequence-derived estimates: molecular mass 49,941.4 Da, pI 4.648, GRAVY -0.302, instability index 34.448.
Pfam matches: Tubulin PF00091.32 at residues 3–212 and Tubulin_C PF03953.23 at residues 261–381.
Beta-tubulin contributes to microtubules as an alpha/beta heterodimer; reference annotation supports GTP binding and GTPase activity; Mg2+ cofactor; cytoplasm/cytoskeleton localization.
